messages.author: 4b06c0bae2d1991d
messages.subject: mirtCAT constraints
parts:
I'm using mirtCAT to simulate item selection from a multidimensional model with 3 correlated factors and 5 nuisance factors representing locally-dependent items. I want to use the constraints option in mirtCAT so that only one item from the locally-dependent pair is selected [ constraints = list(independent=c(#,#)) ]. The error I get is about "ordered" constraints, which I am not using. A reproducible example is attached. Any help?
Aaron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT constraints
parts:
I noticed that as well, and am wondering if an internal change should be made whereby a warning is thrown instead of an error. What happens is that your pool of items runs out, so your CAT never successfully converges given the termination criteria. A change would have to be made to the returned objects with perhaps a logical flag to indicate successful convergence or not. I can put this on the TODO list if you feel this behaviour is more expected.

Phil
